vectors.name: response-ed25519
vectors.description: Response signed by agent B over @status plus the request's @method/@target-uri/@authority/content-digest/signature with ;req, and the response content-type/content-digest. The request carries the ed25519 request signature vector.

vectors.name: tag-present
vectors.description: E03-03: request-ed25519 as received, with ;tag="x" added to Signature-Input, re-signed; rejected when the signature parameters are checked (03 §5 step 2).

vectors.name: unknown-param
vectors.description: E03-03: request-ed25519 as received, with the undefined parameter ;foo=1 added to Signature-Input, re-signed; rejected when the signature parameters are checked (03 §5 step 2).

vectors.name: noncanonical-params
vectors.description: E03-05: request-ed25519 as received, with a second space between the first two covered components; the signature is unchanged, as it is over the canonical serialisation (03 §2); rejected when Signature-Input and Signature are parsed (03 §5 step 1).

vectors.name: two-labels
vectors.description: E03-06: request-ed25519 as received, with a second label sig2 (a copy of sig1) in both dictionaries; rejected when Signature-Input and Signature are parsed (03 §5 step 1).

vectors.name: label-sets-differ
vectors.description: E03-06: request-ed25519 as received, with the Signature label renamed to sig2; rejected when Signature-Input and Signature are parsed (03 §5 step 1).

vectors.name: repeated-label
vectors.description: E03-06: request-ed25519 as received, with the sig1 member repeated in both dictionaries; rejected when Signature-Input and Signature are parsed (03 §5 step 1).

vectors.name: two-signature-input-lines
vectors.description: E03-07: request-ed25519 as received, with a second Signature-Input field line with the same value; rejected when Signature-Input and Signature are parsed (03 §5 step 1).

vectors.name: signature-input-too-large
vectors.description: E03-21: request-ed25519 as received, with a covered field x-pad-aaa… (present in the request with the value 1) whose name makes Signature-Input 8 KiB + 1 bytes, re-signed; rejected by the field size limit before parsing (E03-21).

vectors.name: no-created
vectors.description: E03-02: request-ed25519 as received, with created removed from Signature-Input, re-signed; rejected when the signature parameters are checked (03 §5 step 2).

vectors.name: no-nonce
vectors.description: E03-10: request-ed25519 as received, with nonce removed from Signature-Input, re-signed; rejected when the signature parameters are checked (03 §5 step 2).

vectors.name: body-without-digest-coverage
vectors.description: E03-10: request-ed25519 as received, with content-digest removed from the covered components, re-signed (the body and its Content-Digest kept); rejected when the covered components are checked (03 §5 step 2).

vectors.name: covers-request-target
vectors.description: E03-08: request-ed25519 as received, with "@request-target" covered after "@authority", re-signed; rejected when the covered components are checked (03 §5 step 2).

vectors.name: covers-path
vectors.description: E03-08: request-ed25519 as received, with "@path" covered after "@authority", re-signed; rejected when the covered components are checked (03 §5 step 2).

vectors.name: covers-query-param
vectors.description: E03-08: request-ed25519 as received, with the query ?q=1 added to the target URI and "@query-param";name="q" covered after "@authority", re-signed; rejected when the covered components are checked (03 §5 step 2).

vectors.name: authority-not-normal
vectors.description: E03-08: request-ed25519 as received, with the default port in the target URI (https://agent-b.example:443/...), so @authority is agent-b.example:443, re-signed over that value (a verifier that normalised @authority instead of rejecting it would fail the signature); rejected when the covered components are checked (03 §5 step 2).

vectors.name: component-param-sf
vectors.description: E03-09: request-ed25519 as received, with "content-type";sf covered instead of "content-type", re-signed; rejected when the covered components are checked (03 §5 step 2).

vectors.name: req-in-request
vectors.description: 03 §4: request-ed25519 as received, with "@method";req covered instead of "@method", re-signed; rejected when the covered components are checked (03 §5 step 2).

vectors.name: response-no-status
vectors.description: E03-10: response-ed25519 as received, with "@status" removed from the covered components, re-signed; rejected when the covered components are checked (03 §5 step 2).

vectors.name: response-no-signature-req
vectors.description: E03-10: response-ed25519 as received, with "signature";req removed from the covered components, re-signed; rejected when the covered components are checked (03 §5 step 2).

vectors.name: response-other-request
vectors.description: E03-10: response-ed25519 as received, with the response re-signed with "@target-uri";req https://agent-b.example/mcp/tools/list, another request's value, and checked against request-ed25519; rejected when the signature is verified (03 §5 step 6).
